roadmapTask: Add a ref-addressable page-model snapshot to tools/chrome-bridge: a new pageModel page action that walks the active tab's top-frame DOM via a MAIN-world-injected function and returns a compact, row-capped array of actionable/interactive elements, each with a stable queryable ref, role, name and a viewport bounding box {x,y,width,height}, so an MCP agent feeds the bbox center to the existing clickAt/hover without a CSP-fragile executeScript. DOM-only (no CDP/debugger, no new manifest permission), existing 16 page actions unchanged, top-frame only, single foundational slice of the broader claude-in-chrome replacement.
